summary: National Health Investors Inc. (NHI) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the sale of 35 skilled nursing and independent living facilities to NHC/OP, L.P., a subsidiary of National HealthCare Corporation (NHC), for $560 million. The transaction closed on July 1, 2026, following a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated April 21, 2026. NHI's Special Committee of independent directors, advised by unnamed advisors, unanimously approved the deal. The Master Lease was terminated for all but four Florida facilities, which were assigned to an NHC subsidiary. NHC owned 1,630,642 NHI shares as of December 2025. Watch for NHI's use of proceeds and potential reinvestment or capital return plans.
